Vol. 0112 screensSample world: Money & freedom
Why she comes back

A magazine has a rhythm. So does she.

Good-addictive means there is always something new and it is always hers. Every hook reuses a feature we already have, so none of them add build time.

Every day · 1 minuteA new "Today" story

One line in her world, on one of her images. The pink ring on Home says "new for you". Tap, feel it, done.

Every weekHer Issue grows toward 40 pages

Her move becomes proof, the proof becomes a page, and every page brings her closer to print ("14 of 40 · 26 to print"). Earned, real, hers.

Every 3 months40 pages: ready to print

Her full Issue, all 40 pages, is ready to print. A cover reveal like a real launch, then Issue 02 begins.

We never use:Streaks that breakGuilt notificationsEndless feedsLikes or follower countsFake urgencyRed badges

If she misses a week, nothing is lost. Her Issue waits for her.

The screens

Twelve screens. That's V1.

Screen 10 is your own Lucky Star design.

Lucky Star · designed

Your pink glow. One card at a time.

Your Lucky Star look (the aura, the cream 11, the big type, "Talk to Lucky Star…") with the UX worked out for every moment in V1.

One card, never a thread

Each answer replaces the last. Her previous line stays small on top.

Always says why

"Why this?" names the words or images it used. No invented facts about her.

Nothing without her tap

Every change waits for a button, then shows Undo for 5 seconds.

Knows the screen

The top label says where she is (Home, My World, Sessions). It only helps with that.

Safe words stop it

If she writes something that sounds unsafe, Lucky Star stops and shows real help, every time.

Offline or off

"I need the internet for this. Your Issue is saved." Off means the app still works.
